test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: Who among the following has virtually released the book of English poems titled ‘OH Mizoram’ written by P S Sreedharan Pillai in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M Venkaiah Naidu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **M. Venkaiah Naidu** issues the book **'Oh Mizoram'**, a group of English poems by the **Governor of Mizoram, P S Sreedharan Pillai.**
 
• **Pillai **is a lawyer, a speaker, a creative writer, a philanthropist, and a thinker. 
 
• He has authored 125 books in both Malayalam and English.
 
• Oh, Mizoram is his** first poetry collection in English.**
 
• Muppavarapu Venkaiah Naidu is an Indian politician who worked as the **13th vice president of India from 2017 to 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Exam Warriors** is a book by** Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi, published in 2018.**
 
• **Dr. Jitendra Singh** is an Indian physician and politician.
 
• **Amit Anil Chandra Shah** is an Indian politician presently working as the** Minister of Home Affairs and the first Minister of Co-operation of India. ​ **
